asins.description: Amazon ASINs to look up. Each ASIN is searched (/s?k={ASIN}) and the matching search-result card is scraped, reusing the same search-card parser as other input modes.
asins.title: ASINs

categoryNodeIds.description: Amazon browse-node IDs. Each node ID builds a browse-node/category landing URL (/b?node={id}).
categoryNodeIds.title: Category Node IDs

categoryUrls.description: List of Amazon category or search result URLs to scrape. Supports search pages (e.g., amazon.com/s?k=laptops) and browse nodes (e.g., amazon.com/b?node=123). At least one of Category/Search URLs, Keywords, ASINs, Seller IDs, or Category Node IDs is required.
categoryUrls.title: Category/Search URLs

includeSponsored.description: If true (default), sponsored/ad results are included in the output. Set to false to only return organic results.
includeSponsored.title: Include Sponsored Results

keywords.description: Plain search keywords/phrases. Each keyword builds an Amazon search URL (/s?k={query}) automatically.
keywords.title: Keywords

marketplaceDomain.description: Amazon marketplace domain used to build URLs for the Keywords/ASINs/Seller IDs/Category Node IDs input modes (ignored for Category/Search URLs, which are used as-is).
marketplaceDomain.title: Marketplace Domain

maxItemsPerCategory.description: Maximum number of products to scrape per category URL
maxItemsPerCategory.title: Max Items Per Category

maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to scrape per category
maxPages.title: Max Pages

minRating.description: Only return products with a star rating at or above this value (0-5).
minRating.title: Minimum Rating

onlyDeals.description: If true, only return products with evidence of a deal (coupon, limited-time-deal badge, or a visible list/strike-through price).
onlyDeals.title: Only Deals

priceMax.description: Only return products priced at or below this amount (in dollars).
priceMax.title: Maximum Price ($)

priceMin.description: Only return products priced at or above this amount (in dollars).
priceMin.title: Minimum Price ($)

primeOnly.description: If true, only return products with a visible Amazon Prime badge.
primeOnly.title: Prime Only

proxyCountry.description: Proxy country for geo-targeting. Use AUTO to automatically select based on Amazon domain.
proxyCountry.title: Proxy Country

rateLimitDelay.description: Base delay between requests in seconds to avoid rate limiting
rateLimitDelay.title: Rate Limit Delay (seconds)

scrapeProductDetails.description: If true, scrapes full product details from individual product pages. If false, returns only data visible on category pages (faster).
scrapeProductDetails.title: Scrape Product Details

sellerIds.description: Amazon seller/merchant IDs. Each seller ID builds a storefront search URL (/s?me={sellerId}) listing that seller's products.
sellerIds.title: Seller IDs

sortBy.description: Sort order applied to search/category results.
sortBy.title: Sort By

useResidentialProxy.description: Start every session on residential proxies (more reliable but more expensive ~$12.50/GB). Default (false) uses datacenter proxies (~$0.50/GB) and automatically escalates a session to residential only after repeated blocks.
useResidentialProxy.title: Use Residential Proxy
